eval: const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(d=>d.title==='Oracle Jungle Zone · act1'); const r=t.getBoundingClientRect(); return { tabText: t.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' '), rect:{x:Math.round(r.left),y:Math.round(r.top),w:Math.round(r.width),h:Math.round(r.height)}, closeBtns: [...t.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>getComputedStyle(e).cursor==='pointer'&&e!==t).map(e=>{const q=e.getBoundingClientRect();return {tag:e.tagName,x:Math.round(q.left+q.width/2),y:Math.round(q.top+q.height/2),title:e.getAttribute('title')}}) };
